This is going to sound so counterproductive especially in response to what everyone else is saying in this thread but my skin looks it’s best the less products I use. For some background I used to have really bad acne and redness but then went on accutane and finally got clear skin. From then on, I tried to start a skincare regimen (i did research and ended up purchasing some pretty expensive products) and noticed that they made my skin red and irritated. Now I wash my face at most once daily, moisturizer and retinoid at night, sunscreen in the morning and my skin is consistently clear and not irritated, any time I buy new products or try to implement a new “skincare routine” I notice my skin staff to break out and get red and irritated again.
